fullTextZH: 今天我要带你们跟我一起去上班。
fullTextEN: Today I will take you to work with me.

fullTextZH: 你们看，这里是不是很漂亮啊？

fullTextEN: Next to it are green fields,
and in front are many mountains.
Today's weather is not very good,
In Yilan, we often, very often
have rain, I really don't like it.

fullTextZH: 可是宜兰真的太漂亮了，
fullTextEN: But Yilan is really too beautiful,

fullTextZH: 对，我平常是一个中文老师，
fullTextEN: Yes, I am usually a Chinese teacher,

fullTextZH: 但是我也在咖啡厅工作。
fullTextEN: but I also work in a café.

fullTextZH: 因为我很喜欢跟客人聊天啊，
fullTextEN: Because I really like chatting with customers,
Or the feeling of making coffee.
I feel very relaxed and it's fun.
Because I often work with a computer

fullTextZH: 所以我们咖啡厅没有什么人。
fullTextEN: so our café doesn't have many people.

fullTextZH: 如果有客人，我会很开心，
fullTextEN: If there are customers, I will be very happy,
because if there are no customers,
I find it a bit funny,

fullTextZH: 他给我喝喝看他做的巧克力牛奶。
fullTextEN: He let me try the chocolate milk he made.
So I found it very funny.

fullTextZH: 这就是为什么我喜欢在咖啡厅工作，
fullTextEN: This is why I like working in a café,

fullTextZH: 因为我可以跟不同的人、
fullTextEN: because I can interact with different people,
I am waiting for the customer to give me money.
Then he, he looked for his money,
He searched for a long time.

fullTextZH: 好，那我们要开始做咖啡了。
fullTextEN: Okay, then we will start making coffee.
The coffee beans in our café

fullTextZH: 是伊利这个牌子的咖啡豆。
你们喜欢喝伊利的咖啡吗？
fullTextEN: Do you like drinking Illy coffee?

fullTextZH: 或是你们喜欢喝什么的咖啡呢？
fullTextEN: Or what kind of coffee do you like to drink?

fullTextZH: 现在我在做我们的蛋糕。
fullTextEN: Now I am making our cake.

fullTextZH: 就是让蛋糕看起来漂亮一点。
fullTextEN: just making the cake look a bit prettier.
There is a little sweet powdered sugar.

fullTextZH: 然后我把蛋糕放在盘子上面。
fullTextEN: Then I put the cake on the plate.

fullTextZH: 或是你也可以说它是巴斯克蛋糕。
fullTextEN: Or you can also call it a Basque cake.

fullTextZH: 现在我们在做很多杯的咖啡。
fullTextEN: Now we are making a lot of cups of coffee.

fullTextZH: 好像有十几杯的咖啡吧。
fullTextEN: It seems like there are more than ten cups of coffee.

fullTextZH: 我跟我的同事一起做这些咖啡。
fullTextEN: My colleague and I make these coffees together.

fullTextZH: 然后我们很快地，把这些咖啡做好。
fullTextEN: Then we quickly finish making these coffees.
I think this is also fun.

fullTextZH: 你们看，现在我们有很多客人。
fullTextEN: Look, now we have many guests.
Look, there is a little black dog,

fullTextZH: 现在我们的田都绿绿的。
fullTextEN: Now all our fields are green.

fullTextZH: 这是我们吃饭的那个米饭。
fullTextEN: This is the rice we eat.

fullTextZH: 下班后，我常常会去吃一些小东西，
fullTextEN: After work, I often go eat some snacks,

fullTextZH: 你们常常会看到的小吃店。
fullTextEN: the snack shops you often see.
I want to add a little spice,

fullTextZH: 然后我加了一点点辣椒。
fullTextEN: Then I added a little chili.

fullTextZH: 我很喜欢吃面的时候加一点辣椒，
fullTextEN: I really like to add a little chili when eating noodles,
Also add a little black vinegar.

fullTextZH: 如果你来宜兰或是台湾，
fullTextEN: If you come to Yilan or Taiwan,
You must try the dry noodles,

fullTextZH: 我觉得这是很多、很多的台湾人，
fullTextEN: I think this is something many, many Taiwanese people,
In front of me is a TV,

fullTextZH: 所以我一边吃饭，一边看电视。
fullTextEN: So I eat while watching TV.

fullTextZH: 这个也是台湾人很喜欢做的事情，
fullTextEN: This is also something Taiwanese people love to do,

fullTextZH: 这就是我平常上班的一天，
没有什么很特别的事情，

fullTextEN: Do you also want to try

fullTextZH: 宜兰的干面还有馄饨汤吗？
fullTextEN: Yilan's dry noodles and wonton soup?

fullTextZH: 好啦，那我们就下次见，拜拜！
fullTextEN: Alright, then we'll see you next time, bye!
